releaseNotes:
• Automatic Startup OTA Check: Checks version.json automatically on app launch with cache-busting so new live commits are detected immediately.
• Auto-Release CI Workflow: Automatically builds and publishes signed APKs to live on every commit to main.
• Android User Policy & Restricted Settings (v2.0.0): Built-in Health Connect rationale, Restricted Settings guide (12623953), and Scoped Storage compliance.
